row.name: flutter-hatcha-app
row.description: A showcase vignette for the Flutter GenUI ecosystem. Hatcha demonstrates how to build a party-planning agent with the Google ADK, utilizing the A2UI SDK to generate dynamic, context-aware interfaces in real-time.
